gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Opt-in witness disc only; off in every preset.

input_constraints: Pinned USA pilot TXTR wrappers and audited executable consumer ranges; one to three explicit artwork filenames.
scorebug.png 128x128, field_logo.png 512x512, helmet.png 512x512, or same-basename NFL 2K5 .2ktexmaster. Files up to 32 MiB, expanded masters up to 64 MiB, source images up to 16 megapixels.
Shared P8 palette, native mip count, exact retail or matching authored recipe; mixed or foreign selections refuse.
Only xemu-64 is selectable and remains unwitnessed. xemu-128 and 4x texture output refuse.
portme: Run Noah's native versus 2x artwork comparisons at xemu rendering scales 1x, 2x and 4x, including full-game memory and lifecycle checks.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute generated game spans or discs.

runtime.scope: Static normalized UV evidence, bounded compiler and transaction tests, and real disc builds. Exhaustive runtime consumers, guest heap headroom, rendered sampling and 128 MiB support are unproved.
